address: 8 Jalan Aston, Bukit Mertajam, Seberang Perai, 14000, Malaysia
bio: Since 1962, this cart outside Cathay Food Court has been serving only one dish – Apam Balik, or chargrilled pancake with sugar peanut filling. Made on the spot and served piping hot, it’s crispy on the outside, chewy on the inside....
